## How I built it
Vanilla mode; the five-aspect panel and configured judge pair ran (primary judge: no findings; independent judge: numeric-precision finding); the consume reviewer returned NEEDS CHANGES with 4 IMPORTANT findings and 0 critical, all fixed in the single terminal self-review round across 6 implementation files, with no post-fix panel per policy; friction: direct install to the existing consumer was denied without interactive permission, but the package regression test completed an offline install, and the landing audit was rerun with its explicit session binding.

| Round | Findings | Fixed | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 4 verified IMPORTANT; independent judge flagged numeric precision | 0 in review round | 🟡 routed to terminal self-review |
| Terminal self-review / final verification | 4 parked IMPORTANT | 4 | 🟢 fixed; final suite and acceptance passed |

## Self-Review Summary
| Dimension | Verdict | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Architecture | 🟢 clean | `prepack` builds distribution files before packing |
| Consistency | 🟢 clean | CLI token checks align with API integer constraints |
| Edge-cases | 🟢 clean | Overflow, exact decimals, rounding, and input cap covered |
| Test coverage | 🟢 clean | 17 tests; branch coverage exceeded threshold |
| Security | 🟢 clean | Stdin bounded; rounded numeric tokens rejected |
| Simplification | 🟢 clean | Dependency-free; existing formatter preserved |
| Conventions | 🟢 clean | ESM and built-in test patterns retained |

Single terminal fix round ran: added prepack build, 1 MiB stdin cap, installed-bin process coverage, and exact JSON numeric validation; all four ledger findings fixed without a re-review.

Nothing open.

Optional next step: /zensu-converge — flow-back audit of the code against the plan's Requirements table.

## TL;DR
The invoice quote library and CLI shipped with all four acceptance criteria passing, the full suite green, and the ticket-bound chain closed without a commit or push.
